definition: A lien creditor is a creditor with a security interest in the debtor’s property to support the creditor’s claim. The Uniform Commercial Code §9-102(52) defines a lien creditor as:  A creditor that has acquired a lien on the property involved by attachment, levy, or the like;  An assignee for benefit of creditors from the time of assignment;  A trustee in bankruptcy from the date of the filing of the petition; or  A receiver in equity from the time of appointment.
